## Jira issue

Link the primary issue: `ASP-<ID>` — https://ai-study-planner-nhom.atlassian.net/browse/ASP-<ID>

## Change summary

Explain the **user-visible behavior** before and after, or why this is only an internal change.

## Requirements / code impact declaration

> Fill in exactly one value for each field; these lines are checked automatically when product requirements or app code are changed.

Requirements impact: needs-po-decision
Requirements rationale: Describe which Jira AC and `requirements.md` rule are affected, or why none need changing.

Code impact: implementation-needed
Code rationale: Describe code change needed for requirements, or why requirements-only changes need no implementation.

Test evidence: Not run — replace with commands and actual results, or a specific reason tests could not run.

## Acceptance Criteria and proof

Link AC and tests/screenshots here. Do **not** claim pass for checks that were not run.

## Risks and dependencies

Mention auth (ASP-12), data/DB impact, migration, rollout, backward compatibility, and any open PO decision where relevant.

## Review checklist

- [ ] Jira issue and AC are current.
- [ ] User-visible change and impact fields are truthful.
- [ ] `requirements.md` and code are reconciled, or the gap/next action is explicit.
- [ ] Tests that ran are listed with evidence; untested parts are called out.
- [ ] No secrets or personal data were committed.
- [ ] At least one other Developer has reviewed before merging (Working Agreement draft).
